meta.description: ACCEPTANCE, movement answer: run the traversal slice into the Seed-Pod Tripod's marked landing zone (?mortar=1 solo stage) and answer the denial with movement only. Fully closed-loop, zero timed inputs: the approach is the proven polyp skeleton (bunny-hop off each actual landing while x<52.8, air-jump on each falling edge inside the chimney shaft x 38-47 below roof height, pinned-recovery backstop), which climbs onto the shared overhang roof and walks its top to the lip at x=57. The mortar lesson is then exactly three rules: do not COMMIT off the roof lip onto the post-mid strip while the zone is marked (mortarMarked gates that hold, so a lit mark visibly parks the bot at the lip), never STOP inside the strip once committed (the in-strip hold has no gate — crossing a marked patch is always allowed, standing in it is what is denied), and keep running once past it. Every mortar reaction keys off the emplacement's own telemetry state; nothing is timed. Measured 3/3 on this tree: completed (TRAVERSAL CLEAR), 0 kills, hp 3/3, one full lob -> fuse -> burst cycle observed with the bot held at the lip through it and crossing the strip inside the reload window. Regression signals: a stall short of the rejoin, hp < 3 (the bot never stands in the mark, so a hit means the slab denies more than the mark it draws), or a trace with no mortar state change at all (the emplacement never armed).

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

metrics.deathsScope: fixture-only (sliceStats.attempts increments; always 0 in the default run — use lives.spent)

lives.unavailableReason: no lives readout in this trace — the HUD prints ×N only outside the traversal slice (src/ui/hud.js)

route.method: greedy nearest-connector-in-order match against the game's own TRAVERSAL_FIXTURE (imported from src/pure/traversal.js), radius 2.2 tiles — approximate, not a topological solve. routeIds (A.5 "route coverage") lists every route with >= 3 connectors matched in order; matchedRouteId/confidence is this harness's supplementary single-best-guess summary.

protoScore.note: proxy: airborneKills/links are approximated from kills+grounded and the route matcher, not real HB.score.events — see README
